title: Matriz de compatibilidad de ejecución Three.js

python_reference_kernels.scope: Pruebas numéricas aisladas en Python estándar; no son ejecución JavaScript ni Three.js.

javascript_cpu.scope: JavaScript ES modules executed with Node.js 22; 22 parity tests compare JS results against the Python reference values. These are isolated CPU kernels, not browser rendering.

webgl2.scope: CI software-rendered WebGL2 smoke/integration validation. This proves shader compilation and deterministic pixel probes in Chromium/SwiftShader, not hardware performance or mobile-device compatibility.

webgpu_tsl.failure: Chromium headless test timed out waiting for window.webgpuTslResult after 30s; native WebGPU adapter/device initialization vs Three.js init/TSL render was not isolated by the original test.
webgpu_tsl.scope: Not a WebGPU pass. Next diagnostic run records navigator.gpu, adapter acquisition, renderer initialization, TSL render and queue completion separately; WebGL2 fallback remains rejected.

compatibility_rules: JavaScript CPU: validar funciones, tipos, rangos, determinismo, precisión y resultados frente a los casos de referencia.
WebGL2: validar GLSL ES 3.00, compilación/enlace, formatos de textura, render targets, límites de precisión y resultado visual.
WebGPU/TSL: validar WebGPU disponible, compilación de nodos TSL/WGSL, bindings, formatos, compute/render pipelines y equivalencia numérica.
No se considera una técnica compatible con los tres entornos por el mero hecho de tener una fórmula o un shader GLSL.
ShaderMaterial/RawShaderMaterial y onBeforeCompile no se consideran automáticamente portables a WebGPURenderer; la ruta TSL debe ser explícita.

tests: Create a real WebGL2 context in headless Chromium with a software adapter only as a CI smoke test
Compile/link GLSL ES 3.00 vertex and fragment shaders
Render and read back SDF smooth-min, halftone and depth/normal probes
Check pixel values against numeric references
next_execution_batch.exit_criteria: Context creation, shader compile/link and pixel probes pass; record adapter/renderer and precision. A software CI pass does not certify target-phone performance.

tests: Create Three.js WebGPURenderer and TSL node material
Port SDF smooth minimum, Schlick Fresnel and Beer-Lambert transmittance
next_execution_batch.exit_criteria: Adapter/device and render pipeline succeed; shader validation and numeric probes match tolerances. WebGPU result remains separate from WebGL2.

known_limits: A successful Python numerical test does not establish JavaScript runtime correctness.
A successful WebGL2 shader does not establish WebGPU/TSL compatibility.
A successful WebGPU pipeline does not establish acceptable performance on the user's target device.
Visual evidence requires a captured browser/render execution; none is currently claimed.
